# Goldspade — Forged for Founders

> Goldspade is an engineering-led digital studio based in Pune, Maharashtra. We architect, design, and build bespoke websites, custom web applications, product engineering, and AI business automation for ambitious founders and enterprises across India.

## Studio Details
- **Official Website**: https://www.goldspade.in
- **Headquarters**: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- **Contact Email**: rohit@goldspade.in
- **Primary Practices**: Brand Strategy, UI/UX Product Design, Full-Stack Web Development, Custom Software Engineering & AI Integration.
- **Delivery Model**: 2-week structured sprints, direct access to founding engineers, 100% intellectual property ownership.

## Core Services
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.goldspade.in/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke web applications, microservices, internal operational tools, and enterprise workflow engines.
- [Product Engineering](https://www.goldspade.in/services/product-engineering): Scalable digital products, MVP development, technical architecture, and SaaS platforms built on Next.js.
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.goldspade.in/services/website-design-development): High-converting, Awwwards-caliber marketing websites with sub-second Core Web Vitals.
- [AI Solutions & Automation](https://www.goldspade.in/services/ai-solutions): Pragmatic LLM integrations, document retrieval engines, and workflow automation.
- [Digital Brand Identity](https://www.goldspade.in/services/brand-identity): Distinctive visual systems, typography, design tokens, and comprehensive brand guidelines.
- [Technical SEO & Performance](https://www.goldspade.in/services/seo-growth): Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Schema.org architectures, and Core Web Vitals engineering.

## Selected Portfolio & Case Studies
- [BrandBattle](https://www.goldspade.in/work/brandbattle): Gamified real-time brand comparison platform with instant polling architecture and dynamic leaderboards.
- [Nityasādhanā](https://www.goldspade.in/work/nityasadhana): Mindful habit and ritual tracker progressive web app with local-first offline synchronization.
- [Saanjgarva](https://www.goldspade.in/work/saanjgarva): Luxury hospitality and bespoke resort brand experience in western Maharashtra.
- [Jar Financial](https://www.goldspade.in/work/jar): Micro-savings and financial micro-investment mobile interface concept.
- [Hotel Atithi Karad](https://www.goldspade.in/work/hotel-atithi-karad): Regional hospitality digital presence and room booking portal.
- [Mamacha Mala](https://www.goldspade.in/work/mamacha-mala): Agro-tourism resort digital destination and regional event venue.

## Engineering Perspectives & Research
- [Why We Default to Next.js App Router for Production](https://www.goldspade.in/journal/why-we-default-to-nextjs-app-router): Technical architecture analysis of React Server Components, streaming HTML, and caching strategies.
- [The Death of the Redesign: Incremental Product Evolution](https://www.goldspade.in/journal/death-of-the-redesign-incremental-evolution): Why ambitious brands replace disruptive multi-year redesigns with continuous sprint improvements.
- [Technical SEO in the Age of Answer Engines (AEO)](https://www.goldspade.in/journal/technical-seo-in-the-age-of-answer-engines): How to structure Schema.org, semantic HTML, and direct factual passages for search engines and LLMs.
- [How Founders Should Evaluate Web Development Partners in India](https://www.goldspade.in/journal/evaluating-web-development-partners-india): Practical criteria for evaluating freelancers, traditional agencies, and focused engineering studios.
